notes: No published 4-year plan exists for this specialization: the catalog's 'Catalog four-year plan' section only links out to the College of Agriculture and Natural Resources' general roadmap page (4yearplans.umd.edu), with no AREC-specific term grid. This plan is CONSTRUCTED from the catalog's own requirement rows instead (docs/project/owner-review.md flags this). Gen Ed courses are left out; only the major is audited.

Microeconomics gateway filled with AREC240 (the environment-focused alternative to ECON200); ECON200 or AREC250 would satisfy it equally. Business/Applied Economic Statistics gateway filled with ECON230; BMGT230 would satisfy it equally. Elementary Statistics gateway filled with STAT400; STAT100 or MATH107 would satisfy it equally. Calculus gateway filled with MATH140; MATH120 would satisfy it equally.

This specialization's 'select five' slot is filled with AREC405, AREC422, AREC445, AREC453 and AREC466, all real, currently-approved AREC courses from the builder brief's approved-course list, picked from the catalog's own named list for this specialization.
The Field choice is filled with the Agricultural, Food and Natural Resource Systems field: AREC210, ANSC101 and PLSC112, all named directly in the catalog's field list.
